title: HC1 PBMC, Blood, Healthy control
extract_protocol_ch1: PBMCs were isolated from ethylene diamine tetraacetic acid (EDTA) anticoagulated venous blood by Ficoll-Hypaque (Merck KGaA, Cat# GE17-1440-02) density gradient centrifugation. Briefly, blood samples were centrifuged at 450 xg for 10 minutes. The supernatant (plasma) was collected and preserved at -80°C. PBMCs were then isolated by Ficoll through density gradient centrifugation at 700 xg, with the acceleration set to 4 and the deceleration set to 1. Following centrifugation, cells from the plasma-Ficoll interface were collected and subsequently transferred to a new tube, then washed twice with phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) at 450 xg for 10 minutes. The resulting precipitates were resuspended in the cryopreservation liquid containing 90% fetal bovine serum (FBS) (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Cat# 100010023) and 10% dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) (Merck KGaA, Cat# 200-664-3).

Gene expression libraries were generated using the Chromium Fixed RNA Profiling workflow with the Human Transcriptome Probe Set, a probe-hybridization/ligation–based assay that targets around 18,532 genes. The method for cell counting and viability detection involves sample staining with a fluorescent dye (AO/PI Staining Solution kit, CS2-0106-5mL, Nexcelom Biosciences) and cell quantification with an automated fluorescent cell counter (Cellaca counter, MX-112-0127, Nexcelom Biosciences). Subsequently, probe hybridization was conducted, followed by partitioning in Gel Bead-in-Emulsion (GEM), ligation, and extension within the GEMs, culminating in library construction. Libraries were then loaded onto a high-throughput sequencing platform NextSeq500 (Illumina) to generate large amounts of RNA sequencing data.

title: PLWH9 PBMC, Blood, HIV-infected (cART)
extract_protocol_ch1: PBMCs were isolated from ethylene diamine tetraacetic acid (EDTA) anticoagulated venous blood by Ficoll-Hypaque (Merck KGaA, Cat# GE17-1440-02) density gradient centrifugation. Briefly, blood samples were centrifuged at 450 xg for 10 minutes. The supernatant (plasma) was collected and preserved at -80°C. PBMCs were then isolated by Ficoll through density gradient centrifugation at 700 xg, with the acceleration set to 4 and the deceleration set to 1. Following centrifugation, cells from the plasma-Ficoll interface were collected and subsequently transferred to a new tube, then washed twice with phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) at 450 xg for 10 minutes. The resulting precipitates were resuspended in the cryopreservation liquid containing 90% fetal bovine serum (FBS) (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Cat# 100010023) and 10% dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) (Merck KGaA, Cat# 200-664-3).

Gene expression libraries were generated using the Chromium Fixed RNA Profiling workflow with the Human Transcriptome Probe Set, a probe-hybridization/ligation–based assay that targets around 18,532 genes. The method for cell counting and viability detection involves sample staining with a fluorescent dye (AO/PI Staining Solution kit, CS2-0106-5mL, Nexcelom Biosciences) and cell quantification with an automated fluorescent cell counter (Cellaca counter, MX-112-0127, Nexcelom Biosciences). Subsequently, probe hybridization was conducted, followed by partitioning in Gel Bead-in-Emulsion (GEM), ligation, and extension within the GEMs, culminating in library construction. Libraries were then loaded onto a high-throughput sequencing platform NextSeq500 (Illumina) to generate large amounts of RNA sequencing data.

title: PLWH5 PBMC, Blood, HIV-infected (cART)
extract_protocol_ch1: PBMCs were isolated from ethylene diamine tetraacetic acid (EDTA) anticoagulated venous blood by Ficoll-Hypaque (Merck KGaA, Cat# GE17-1440-02) density gradient centrifugation. Briefly, blood samples were centrifuged at 450 xg for 10 minutes. The supernatant (plasma) was collected and preserved at -80°C. PBMCs were then isolated by Ficoll through density gradient centrifugation at 700 xg, with the acceleration set to 4 and the deceleration set to 1. Following centrifugation, cells from the plasma-Ficoll interface were collected and subsequently transferred to a new tube, then washed twice with phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) at 450 xg for 10 minutes. The resulting precipitates were resuspended in the cryopreservation liquid containing 90% fetal bovine serum (FBS) (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Cat# 100010023) and 10% dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) (Merck KGaA, Cat# 200-664-3).

Gene expression libraries were generated using the Chromium Fixed RNA Profiling workflow with the Human Transcriptome Probe Set, a probe-hybridization/ligation–based assay that targets around 18,532 genes. The method for cell counting and viability detection involves sample staining with a fluorescent dye (AO/PI Staining Solution kit, CS2-0106-5mL, Nexcelom Biosciences) and cell quantification with an automated fluorescent cell counter (Cellaca counter, MX-112-0127, Nexcelom Biosciences). Subsequently, probe hybridization was conducted, followed by partitioning in Gel Bead-in-Emulsion (GEM), ligation, and extension within the GEMs, culminating in library construction. Libraries were then loaded onto a high-throughput sequencing platform NextSeq500 (Illumina) to generate large amounts of RNA sequencing data.
